caption: Kar. 118. Stela
reading: wosi : sore?(2)yi : seberlo(3)wi : sebed?en[.] (4)tedḫelowi do(5)keli : terikel (6)antli : wilowi (7)ato : mẖe : psiẖte (8)at : mẖe : psiḫr(9)kte
notes: Line 2: the e of sore?yi is drawn thin between two vertical (crack?) strokes. seber-: the group read as se is a v-shape before two strokes (se or b+y); same in seba?n?n. seba?n?n: a is S plus a hatched 2; the next sign is hatched, n-like; a wavy line and hatching follow before the gap (one lost sign given). A narrow hatch before the i of tedḫelowi is not counted. d?o: hook sign after a slash, read d (could be te). (5)e?kli: S followed by a Sigma-topped long-tailed sign, read e+k; a (S2) also possible. 'li' here and in ap?otli is a 4 joined to a small l-hook. ap?otli: p could be k; t is a dot before a hook. terikel ends the row and the next row starts ap-, so -owi of terikelowi is not on the copy. wilowi?: final i hatched. The sign before te in psiẖ?te and psiḫrẖ?te is a 3/2 with a tail: ẖ by shape, formula would suggest ḫ. Line order unclear at lines 4-6 (row breaks do not fit the line numbers neatly).
check_notes: All 14 entries placed. Index A 'ant li : wilowi' and Index B 'antli : wilowi' both placed at line 6. Names table and Index C agree on A seberlowi, B sebed(?)en[.], C dokeli. terikel ends a row with no -owi on the copy; no entry covers it. Formula A and B tables agree with the copy, dividers included.

caption: Kar. 119. Stela
reading: wosi : soreyi : ar?e?[.](2)qor qowi : ant mn(3)pt yenmdelowi : (4)amewil : terike(5)lowi : stkiñyi : te(6)dḫe?owi : ḫm lol : ẖol(7)kte ato mẖe psiẖ(8)te at : mẖe psiḫr(9)kte nsedokel : dole : (10)ẖolkete
notes: Line numbers: 8 is printed above the te of psiẖte in the right half of row 6. Row 1 left: a b?, then a hatched S-like sign (e?), one sign-width of hatching, then so (slash+3, could be q), a tiny hatched sign, r; then so, hatched y?, w, i. Row 2: ant (a written as angular S+2); m? is a 3 with hooked top (could be s or ẖ); p long-tailed. ye?t?mde: two strokes y with a small hook on top of a third stroke (read e), then a long-tailed 2-shape read t; compare yetmdelowi in Kar. 120. Row 3 right: a m, then hatched e? and w?, then a 4-like joined sign (i?), e. Row 4: s t k i d y i; d is a crossed sign with loop (ñ by the key, d by yetmde in Kar. 120). tedḫe?owi: only one sign between ḫ and o, S-like (e), l would fit -lowi. Row 5 right: ḫ, a 3 with long tail (ẖ? or m), then l o l? (left hook larger, could be e). sol-: slash+3 read s o (q possible); k? is a 3 with long underline (ẖ possible). Row 6: ato (to = U-shape with dot below). Row 7: n (long tail), se (v + two strokes), d o k e l : d o l e : s o l k e te.
check_notes: Order of formulae on this stone is C A B E (Griffith, formula E prose). Index A/B print yetmdelowi, Index C prints yenmdelowi for Kar. 61 and 119; the copy's sign is long-tailed like n, so yenmde kept. Copy gaps kept inside ḫm lol and qor qowi where the type writes one word. Formula E prose (p)ẖol: Griffith's supplied p is not on the copy and is not added.

caption: Kar. 120. Altar

reading: wosi : sore(2)yi? : stepeñyiqo(3)wi : s?mkse : tedḫl?o(4)wi : menoteli : te(5)rikel?o(6)wi : pese(7)tol : yetmdelowi : (8)ato : mẖe psiẖte : (9)at : mẖe : psi(10)ḫrkte
notes: sic over the last sign of soreyi: a 4 joined to a hooked stroke. Row 1 left: first sign a flat-topped 3 (m? or s); te is a barred hook with a separate slash; k long-tailed; d crossed with loop (as in yetmde); li = 4 joined to a hook; ẖ = 3 with long tail. m?ase: Sigma+2 read a, v + two strokes read se (b+y possible). tedḫl?owi: one small hook between ḫ and o (l by shape; e would give tedḫe-). menoteli?i: n with separate slash = o; li?i is a 4 with a bar joined to 4 and a hook. kel?o: two alike S-signs, second read l. kese(7)to?e: k long-tailed; to? is a U with a left hook, no dot. ato?: to sign has two small strokes inside (damage?). The last word of line 10 (te) stands under the label 'in field'.
check_notes: Names A/B/C, Index A pesetol yetmdelo(wi), Index C entries and formulae A and B all placed. The step-1 group 'y li ẖ y' is the type's y i q o: i with long bar crossed by the y strokes, q = slash and 3, o the other slash; no sign of the copy is lost by this, only re-segmented. tedḫl?owi and te-rikel?owi are not covered by any entry and stay as in step 1.
